sourceTitle: A Letter to the Right Honourable the Earl of Derby on the cruelty and injustice of opening the Crystal Palace on the Sabbath
description: "A Letter to the Right Honourable the Earl of Derby" by Benjamin Parsons is a passionate polemic written in the mid-19th century. This work takes the form of an open letter addressing the issues surrounding the proposed opening of the Crystal Palace on the Sabbath, arguing against this practice as a violation of religious observance and a moral wrong.
